title: Planet Tweaks V2.4.9 ULTRA — OmniMend-Style Autonomous PC Doctor, Crash Log & Driver Inspector, 1-Click Auto-Repair
releaseNotes: OmniMend-Grade Autonomous System Doctor: Deep inspection of Windows Minidump kernel crash records, %LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps, Event Viewer application crashes (Event ID 1000/1001), and GPU driver TDR recovery events (Event ID 4101). Hardware & Display Driver Health: Real-time GPU driver version, release date, and WHQL verification with 1-click update launching. System File Integrity & CBS Health: Windows Component Store corruption detection via CBS logs. 1-Click Auto-Repair Engine: Instantly purges corrupted shader caches & crash dumps, synchronizes GPU display pipeline, resets Winsock TCP stack, restores Component Store health, and locks timer resolution to 0.500ms. Zero-Key Cloud AI Architecture: Fully managed free cloud AI endpoint (https://planettweakz.vercel.app/api/ai) — no user ever has to supply or enter their own API key.
